situations.title: 심계항진 초기 문진
situations.tagline: My heart's been fluttering on and off all afternoon and it kind of scares me.
situations.brief: 두근거림의 양상·유발요인·지속 시간을 청취해 초기 병력을 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me when the fluttering started?
Does anything seem to bring it on or make it worse?
How long does each episode usually last?
goals: 증상 시간선을 정리해 초기 병력을 구성한다

situations.title: 활력·리듬 확인 설명
situations.tagline: What are all these stickers and wires for?
situations.brief: 맥박을 확인하고 심전도 모니터 부착 과정을 환자에게 설명하며 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your pulse and put you on a heart monitor.
These stickers just read your heart's rhythm — they don't hurt.
Try to relax your arm for me while I count your pulse.
goals: 모니터 부착 과정을 쉬운 말로 설명한다
활력징후 측정을 환자 협조 속에 수행한다

situations.title: 12유도 심전도 준비
situations.tagline: Do I need to take my shirt off for this test?
situations.brief: 12유도 심전도 전극 부착을 안내하고 움직임을 자제하도록 협조를 구하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll place ten small stickers on your chest, arms, and legs.
Please hold as still as you can for about ten seconds.
This records your heart from twelve different angles.
goals: 정확한 기록을 위해 움직임 자제를 유도한다

situations.title: 카페인·자극제 관련 심계항진
situations.tagline: I had a couple energy drinks to get through my shift — could that be it?
situations.brief: 커피·에너지드링크·기타 자극제와 약 복용 이력을 확인해 유발요인을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How much caffeine do you usually have in a day?
Are you taking any supplements, cold medicine, or diet pills?
The palpitations often settle once the stimulant wears off.

situations.title: 양성 조기박동 안심 교육
situations.tagline: The doctor said my heart is skipping — is that dangerous?
situations.brief: PVC/PAC 등 양성 조기박동임을 재확인하고 재방문 기준을 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: These extra beats are common and usually harmless.
Come back if you faint, have chest pain, or it won't stop.
Cutting back on caffeine and stress often helps a lot.

situations.title: 신규 심방세동 빠른 심실반응
situations.tagline: My heart is racing and skipping — I feel like I might pass out.
situations.brief: 불규칙 빈맥 환자의 리듬을 확인하고 항응고·색전 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to put you on the heart monitor now.
Have you ever been told your heart beats irregularly?
Are you feeling dizzy or short of breath right now?
goals: 불규칙 빈맥과 동반 증상을 신속히 사정한다

situations.title: 발작성 SVT 미주신경자극 설명
situations.tagline: It just started pounding out of nowhere — over 180, I think.
situations.brief: 발작성 SVT 환자에게 미주신경자극(Valsalva)과 adenosine 투여 전 절차를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I want you to bear down like you're straining, and hold it.
If that doesn't work, we'll give a fast medicine through your IV.
You may feel a brief flushing or heavy chest — it passes in seconds.

situations.title: 서맥·현기증 감별
situations.tagline: I keep getting lightheaded like I'm about to black out.
situations.brief: 서맥과 현기증의 관계를 확인하고 실신 전조·약물 유발 여부를 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you feel lightheaded when you stand up or all the time?
Are you on any blood pressure or heart-rate medications?
Have you actually passed out or just felt close to it?

situations.title: 갑상선기능항진 의심
situations.tagline: My heart won't slow down and I've been sweating and losing weight.
situations.brief: 심계항진과 함께 체중감소·발한·손떨림 등 갑상선기능항진 소견을 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you noticed any weight loss without trying?
Do you feel hot, sweaty, or shaky more than usual?
Have you ever had a thyroid problem or taken thyroid pills?

situations.title: 증상 축소 환자 위험신호
situations.tagline: It's probably nothing — I just felt a little funny for a second.
situations.brief: 증상을 축소하는 환자에게 실신·흉통 등 위험신호를 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you, but I need to ask a few important questions.
Did you have any chest pain or come close to fainting?
Even if it felt minor, these symptoms are worth checking.
goals: 증상을 축소하는 환자에게서 핵심 위험신호를 끌어낸다

situations.title: 심계항진+공황 감별
situations.tagline: My heart's pounding and I can't breathe — am I having a heart attack?
situations.brief: 불안·공황과 부정맥에 의한 심계항진을 구분하기 위해 상황과 증상을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Did the racing start with a feeling of panic or fear?
Have you had episodes like this before, and what helped?
Let's slow your breathing together while we check your heart.
goals: 불안 완화 코칭과 심장 사정을 병행한다

situations.title: 항부정맥제 복약 순응도
situations.tagline: I stopped my heart pills a while back because they made me tired.
situations.brief: 항부정맥제 자가중단 여부와 재발 관계를 확인하고 복약 순응도를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last take your heart medication?
What made you stop taking it?
Skipping doses can bring the irregular rhythm back.
goals: 복약 중단과 증상 재발의 관계를 확인한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 리듬 확인
situations.tagline: Corazón... rápido... mucho.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자에게 예/아니오 중심 질문으로 통증·어지럼 등 핵심 증상을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain? Point to where it hurts. Yes or no?
Dizzy? Yes or no?
I'm calling an interpreter to help us.
goals: 폐쇄형 질문으로 핵심 증상을 신속히 확인한다

situations.title: 페이스메이커 오작동 의심
situations.tagline: I have a pacemaker, but my heart feels like it's doing its own thing.
situations.brief: 페이스메이커 이력과 프로그래밍 정보를 확인하고 장치 오작동 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have your pacemaker ID card with you?
When was your device last checked?
Have you had hiccup-like twitching or dizziness?

situations.title: 임신 중 심계항진
situations.tagline: I'm 28 weeks pregnant and my heart keeps racing — is the baby okay?
situations.brief: 임신 중 생리적 심계항진과 병적 부정맥을 감별하고 산모 안심을 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: Some racing is normal in pregnancy, but let's check it carefully.
Any chest pain, fainting, or trouble breathing?
We'll monitor your heart and keep both of you safe.

situations.title: 불안정 SVT 심율동전환 준비
situations.tagline: I'm so dizzy... everything's going gray.
situations.brief: 저혈압·의식저하를 동반한 불안정 SVT에서 진정과 동기화 심율동전환을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Your blood pressure is low and we need to reset your rhythm.
We'll give you medicine to make you sleepy first.
You'll feel a quick shock while you're sedated — we're right here.
goals: 불안정 SVT의 위급성을 인지하고 전환을 준비한다

situations.title: 심실빈맥(VT) 긴급 대응
situations.tagline: My chest is slamming and I feel awful — help me.
situations.brief: 넓은 QRS 빈맥 환자를 즉시 사정하고 제세동·팀 대응을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm calling the team and getting the crash cart now.
Stay with me — are you still with us?
We're placing pads on your chest as a precaution.

situations.title: WPW+심방세동 위험
situations.tagline: They told me I have an extra pathway in my heart, and now it's racing.
situations.brief: WPW 동반 심방세동에서 금기 약물을 인지하고 팀에 즉시 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I need to flag that you have WPW to the team right away.
We'll avoid certain heart medicines that could be dangerous for you.
Have you had this fast, irregular rhythm before?
goals: WPW+AF에서 AV 결절 차단제 금기를 인지한다

situations.title: 완전방실차단 서맥성 실신
situations.tagline: I passed out at home and my heart feels way too slow now.
situations.brief: 완전방실차단 서맥 환자에게 경피 페이싱을 준비하고 의식을 지속 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: Your heart is beating too slowly, so we may need to pace it.
We'll place pads that give gentle electrical pulses.
Squeeze my hand if you can hear me.

situations.title: Torsades·QT연장
situations.tagline: I keep almost blacking out and my heart flutters, then stops, then flutters.
situations.brief: QT연장·Torsades 위험 환자의 약물·전해질을 점검하고 마그네슘 투여를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: What medications have you started recently?
We're checking your potassium and magnesium levels now.
I'm drawing up magnesium to protect your heart rhythm.

situations.title: 부정맥 급속 악화 SBAR
situations.tagline: Her rhythm just changed and her pressure's dropping.
situations.brief: 리듬 변화를 실시간으로 SBAR 형식에 맞춰 의사에게 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: bed 2 just converted to a wide-complex tachycardia.
Her BP dropped to 78 over 40 and she's diaphoretic.
I recommend the team come now and prepare for cardioversion.
goals: 리듬 변화를 SBAR 구조로 간결히 보고한다

situations.title: ICD 반복 쇼크(전기폭풍)
situations.tagline: It keeps shocking me — it's already gone off four times, please make it stop!
situations.brief: ICD 반복 방전(전기폭풍) 환자의 공포를 관리하고 응급 대응을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: I know that was frightening — we're going to help you now.
We'll give medicine to calm your heart and the shocks.
The team is placing a magnet and calling cardiology.
goals: 반복 쇼크로 인한 환자의 공포를 관리한다
